predecessors.name: Duchy of Greater Poland
predecessors.text: Kuyavia, annexed by Mieszko III in 1186 and given to his son Bolesław: 'he took the Kuyavia region and annexed it to his Duchy'

predecessors.name: Duchy of Masovia
predecessors.text: Kuyavia, ruled by Leszek, Duke of Masovia, until his death in 1186

successors.name: Duchy of Masovia
successors.text: Kuyavia, joined to Masovia under Konrad I: 'in 1205, the adjacent lands of Kuyavia as well' (Konrad I of Masovia page); Cliopatria's 1205 shape plus the Inowrocław disc of the keyframes

rulers.name: Bolesław of Kuyavia (son of Mieszko III)
Leszek the White and Konrad (Casimir II's sons)

ledger.x: 1186: Mieszko III the Old annexes Kuyavia and gives it to his son Bolesław.
13 September 1195: Bolesław of Kuyavia dies at Mozgawa.
1198: Mieszko III cedes Kuyavia to Casimir II's sons.
1199: Kuyavia passes to Konrad of Masovia, son of Casimir II.
1205: Konrad I adds Kuyavia to Masovia: 'in 1205, the adjacent lands of Kuyavia as well'.

wars.name: Battle of Mozgawa
wars.outcome: Bloody battle on 13 September 1195: Mieszko III is seriously injured, his son Bolesław of Kuyavia dies and Mieszko withdraws to Kalisz; the page names no winner.

certainty.note: The pages name 'the Kuyavia region' without a boundary; the Cliopatria shape is an approximation of the land between the Vistula, Gostynin and Włocławek.
